question: For each different type of food, if someone orders the second most expensive item in grade size, what is the minimum total amount they would need to pay?

steps.description: Locate the Cold Brew section and read the price of Cold Brew with Coconut Milk NEW!
Compare all items in Cold Brew category to identify the second most expensive item
Locate the Espresso & Coffee section and read the price of Ristretto Bianco
Compare all items in Espresso & Coffee category to identify the second most expensive item
Locate the Teavana Teas section and read the price of Matcha & Espresso Fusion
Compare all items in Teavana Teas category to identify the second most expensive item
Locate the Frappuccino section and read the price of Green Tea
Compare all items in Frappuccino category to identify the second most expensive item
Locate the Other Beverages section and read the price of Signature Hot Chocolate
Compare all items in Other Beverages category to identify the second most expensive item
Add together the second most expensive prices from each category identified in previous steps
